<header class="case-header"><div><p class="breadcrumb"><a href="/projects/">← All projects</a></p><p class="eyebrow">Interactive dashboard</p><h1>SPAR Insights</h1><p class="lead">Explore public SPAR self-assessment data across years, regions, and countries.</p><div class="button-row"><a class="button" href="https://shanlong-who.github.io/spar-insights/">Open dashboard <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a><a class="text-link" href="https://github.com/shanlong-who/spar-insights">View source <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div><a class="project-art spar-art" href="https://shanlong-who.github.io/spar-insights/" aria-label="SPAR Insights"><span class="art-index" aria-hidden="true">04</span><strong>SPAR</strong><span>2021 — 2025</span></a></header>
<div class="case-layout"><article class="prose"><h2>The question</h2><p>How can publicly available SPAR self-assessment data be explored across years, regions, and countries in one place?</p>
<h2>What the dashboard offers</h2><p>Filter the 2021–2025 snapshot by year, WHO region, and State Party. Explore maps, score distributions, country profiles, annual comparisons, searchable comments, and downloadable tables.</p>
<h2>Who it is for</h2><p>People exploring public SPAR reporting who need an accessible way to browse patterns and return to the underlying sources.</p>
<h2>A starting point</h2><p><a href="https://shanlong-who.github.io/spar-insights/">Open the dashboard</a> in a modern browser. No R installation is needed to view it. The repository also provides a self-contained HTML file for offline use.</p>
<h2>Reading the data</h2><p>SPAR is a self-assessment. Country coverage can change between years, missing values differ from zero scores, and later official releases may differ from this snapshot. Read the dashboard’s data notes before making comparisons.</p>
<h2>My contribution</h2><p>I built and maintain this independent exploration tool. The repository includes the build and validation source. It is not an official WHO publication.</p></article><aside class="case-meta" aria-label="Project details"><dl><dt>Format</dt><dd>Browser-based static dashboard</dd><dt>My role</dt><dd>Developer and maintainer</dd><dt>Licence & attribution</dt><dd>Consult the repository and original data-source terms</dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><a href="https://github.com/shanlong-who/spar-insights">spar-insights · GitHub</a><br>Description checked on 3 November 2026.</dd></dl></aside></div>
